_comment: By-DOI rescue manifest, read by build-data.mjs (rescueMissingWorks) in every daily build. Papers listed or discovered here are fetched from Crossref BY DOI and folded into the harvest when the journal-route listing misses them. Per journal key: 'dois' = explicit bare DOIs (a DOI Crossref cannot resolve is reported and skipped — safe probe semantics); 'scans' = {volume} specs resolved against OpenAlex each build. History: the vol-67 OpenAlex scan proved barren (OpenAlex mirrors Crossref's metadata hole — the 'missing' papers were in the catalog all along as frozen no-volume records, repaired via _aia-fixups.json), and the 10.1287/mnsc.2014.1882 probe resolved as a bad citation, NOT a missing paper; both removed. 10.1287/opre.2018.1783 (On the Minimum Chordal Completion Polytope, OR 67(2) pp. 532-547, confirmed via the publisher TOC + RePEc) is genuinely absent from the journal-route harvest and is fetched by DOI here; its volume/issue arrive via its _aia-fixups.json entry.
